domain: internal notes of a small software studio (tools, people, companies, databases, programming languages)

entity_types.name: build_tool
entity_types.desc: A software tool that compiles or builds assets/pipelines.

entity_types.name: company
entity_types.desc: An organization or business entity, e.g. a manufacturer that supplies the studio.

entity_types.name: database
entity_types.desc: A data storage system that holds records or notes.

entity_types.name: person
entity_types.desc: An individual human, e.g. a studio employee who leads a team.

entity_types.name: programming_language
entity_types.desc: A programming language, such as one used for a specific authoring purpose.

entity_types.name: team
entity_types.desc: A group within the studio, such as the platform team or the Wren team.

relation_types.name: leads
relation_types.desc: A person leads or heads a team.

relation_types.name: manufactures
relation_types.desc: A company manufactures or produces goods, such as sensors.

relation_types.name: compiles
relation_types.desc: A build tool compiles or builds something, such as asset pipelines.

relation_types.name: stores
relation_types.desc: A database stores records or data, such as billing records or meeting notes.

relation_types.name: uses
relation_types.desc: A team keeps or stores its information in a database.

relation_types.name: mentioned
relation_types.desc: A person mentioned something, such as a tool, during a discussion.
